entry.name: tableLayout
entry.label: Align the sensors in columns, like a table

entry.name: autoFontSize
entry.label: Automatically fit the font size to the panel height

entry.name: fontSize
entry.label: Font size in pixels (used when auto font size is disabled)

entry.name: uiLanguage
entry.label: User interface language; empty follows the system language

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Font family, empty means the system font

entry.name: showNames
entry.label: Show the sensor name in front of each value

entry.name: itemSpacing
entry.label: Space between two sensors, in pixels

entry.name: labelAlignment
entry.label: Alignment of the sensor names in the table layout (0 left, 1 center, 2 right)

entry.name: valueAlignment
entry.label: Alignment of the sensor values in the table layout (0 left, 1 center, 2 right)

entry.name: separator
entry.label: Optional separator drawn between two sensors

entry.name: showColorBar
entry.label: Draw a small colored bar in front of sensors that have a color

entry.name: autoAdaptColors
entry.label: Adapt the colors automatically to dark/light themes
